nodes.summary: For a topological group $G$, the generator rank $d(G)$ is the least natural number $k$ such that some finite subset of $G$ with $k$ elements generates a dense subgroup of $G$, that is, a subgroup whose closure is all of $G$. If no finite subset of $G$ generates a dense subgroup, then $d(G)$ is defined to be $0$. For a finite discrete group this is the ordinary minimal number of generators.
nodes.title: Generator rank

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime and let $Q$ be a nontrivial finite $p$-group, viewed as a topological group with the discrete topology. Then the generator rank $d(Q)$ and the relation rank $r(Q)$, the dimension over $\mathbb{F}_p$ of the continuous cohomology group $H^2(Q, \mathbb{F}_p)$ with trivial coefficients, satisfy $d(Q)^2 < 4\, r(Q)$.
nodes.title: Golod–Shafarevich inequality

nodes.summary: For a prime $p$ and a topological group $G$, the relation rank $r(G)$ is the dimension over $\mathbb{F}_p = \mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ of the continuous cohomology group $H^2(G, \mathbb{F}_p)$, where $G$ acts trivially on $\mathbb{F}_p$. If this space is infinite-dimensional, then $r(G)$ is defined to be $0$.
nodes.title: Relation rank

nodes.summary: For a natural number $p$ and a topological group $G$, this is $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$, with its discrete topology, regarded as a continuous representation of $G$ over $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ on which every element of $G$ acts as the identity.
nodes.title: Trivial representation on $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
